# Third-party asset licenses

These vendor files are preserved under `Assets/ThirdParty` without editing the
original downloaded files. All supplied license documents are copied beside the
assets. This summary records what the supplied text says; consult the included
license itself for the full terms.

## Quaternius Stylized Nature MegaKit (Standard)

- Source directory: `Stylized Nature MegaKit[Standard]`
- Local license: `Quaternius/StylizedNatureMegaKit/License_Standard.txt`
- Creator: `@Quaternius` (as named in the license)
- License stated in file: `CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0) — Public Domain Dedication`
- Attribution: the file identifies the models as by `@Quaternius`, but does not
  state that attribution is required. It asks readers to consider supporting the
  creator; I have not treated that request as a license condition.
- Source URL included in the file: <https://quaternius.com>

The license notes this Standard free pack contains 68 of 116 models.
